name: MedicalRecord
description: A patient's health information, including diagnoses, treatments, medications, and visit notes.

attributes.name: idOfUser
attributes.description: Owning patient — set automatically on create from the authenticated user; only the owning patient or an admin/doctor may access this record.

attributes.name: patientId
attributes.description: The patient this medical record belongs to.

attributes.name: doctorId
attributes.description: The doctor who created or last updated this record.

attributes.name: recordDate
attributes.description: The date when this medical record entry was created or updated.

attributes.name: recordType
attributes.description: The type of medical record entry (e.g., diagnosis, medication).

attributes.name: content
attributes.description: The detailed content of the medical record entry.

attributes.name: labTestName
attributes.description: Name of the laboratory test performed.

attributes.name: labResultValue
attributes.description: Result value of the laboratory test.

attributes.name: visitSummaryId
attributes.description: Optional link to a visit summary associated with this record.
